title: systemctl says webapp.service is active, but curl to its port fails
description_md:
`webapp.service` is supposed to serve `http://localhost:8080/`. `systemctl is-active webapp` reports `active` -- the unit looks perfectly healthy -- but `curl http://localhost:8080/` times out. A leftover unit from an old canary rollout was never cleaned up after cutover. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), figure out why an "active" unit isn't actually the one answering on its own port, and get the real app serving.

You're done when `curl http://localhost:8080/` succeeds.
